fields.name: MapPgShardKeyAttribute
fields.contract: A property-targeted library attribute that configures a PostgreSQL mapping for a virtual compound key. Construction requires a record identity name and may include a shard identifier name plus zero through four subordinate identity names. When a shard identifier name is supplied, the attribute configures it as a PostgreSQL smallint mapping; otherwise it supplies no shard mapping. Each supplied identity name is retained in its corresponding selector, and the record-identifier flag is true unless the selected overload supplies an explicit value.
